description: Charging sessions, energy added, cost and wallbox power for your vehicle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, COUNT(*) OVER () AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(started_at) AS time, SUM(energy_kwh) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring}
SELECT MAX(started_at) AS time, SUM(cost) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} HAVING COUNT(cost) > 0
SELECT MAX(started_at) AS time, AVG(avg_power_kw) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring}

SELECT started_at AS "Started", ended_at AS "Ended", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ended_at, now()) - started_at))/60.0) AS "Duration (min)", ROUND(charging_seconds/60.0) AS "Charging (min)", start_soc AS "Start SoC %", end_soc AS "End SoC %", energy_kwh AS "Energy (kWh)", pack_kwh AS "Pack (kWh)", thermal_kwh AS "Thermal (kWh)", avg_power_kw AS "Avg kW", max_power_kw AS "Max kW", cost AS "Cost", COALESCE(cost, est_cost) AS "Cost (est.)", charger_type AS "Charger Type", COALESCE(loc_name, CASE WHEN is_home_s THEN 'Home' WHEN is_public THEN 'Public' ELSE 'Other' END) AS "Location" FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} ORDER BY started_at DESC
SELECT started_at AS time, energy_kwh AS "Energy (kWh)" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at
SELECT ts AS time, power AS "Power (kW)" FROM wallbox_readings WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT name || ' - ' || model || ' (max ' || max_power || ' kW)' AS value FROM wallboxes LIMIT 1

SELECT started_at AS time, pack_kwh AS "Pack (kWh)", thermal_kwh AS "Thermal (kWh)" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND (pack_kwh IS NOT NULL OR thermal_kwh IS NOT NULL) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at

SELECT MAX(started_at) AS time, COALESCE(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND NOT is_home_s
